name: current_optimization_stack
benchmark_kind: controlled before/after execution of the relation-paged circuit
scope_warning: One query on the 1,127-entity evaluation fixture, three MP-SPDZ Semi parties on one host. Preprocessing is included. This is not an online-only, WAN, multi-host, malicious-security, or full-dataset measurement.

controlled_variables.fixture: the same /tmp/qa-opt relation-paged fixture and private input files
controlled_variables.protocol: MP-SPDZ Semi, three local parties; passive dishonest majority
controlled_variables.threat_model: unchanged: any two of three servers may collude passively

current_topk_change: Default top-k winner suppression no longer stores a secret integer best_index and compares it with every public candidate index. It stores the already-computed became_best bits and finds the last set bit in one reverse pass. Terminal-deduplication retains terminal equality because it intentionally suppresses all paths ending at the selected terminal.
attribution_caveat: This compares the complete prior generated circuit with the complete current generated circuit. It therefore measures the current optimization stack, including compile-shape changes already present in page_program.py, rather than attributing the entire gain to winner suppression alone.
interpretation: The current circuit is a strict improvement in measured communication, runtime, triples, and reported rounds on this fixture. It is not better in every metric: generated bytecode is 2.6% larger. Communication includes preprocessing and must not be reported as online-only.
